findings.highlight: I was going to show my thanks by making a gorgeous lunch
findings.evidenceJa: 昼食に気合いを入れていたのはちょっとした感謝の気持ちだった
findings.governingReading: Shirou had been putting special effort into their lunches as a small expression of gratitude.
findings.explanation: Was going to makes the care a future one-off plan, while gorgeous invents extravagance in place of sustained effort.
